annotation.title_clean: Presupuestos Mínimos para la Promoción del desarrollo de la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) en la República Argentina
annotation.title_en: Minimum Standards for the Promotion of the Development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the Argentine Republic
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Silvana Giudici, Diputada Nacional (Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina)
annotation.venue: Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
annotation.summary_en: Argentine bill by Deputy Silvana Giudici setting minimum standards to promote AI development, declaring it of strategic national interest. It sets guiding principles, bans certain manipulative or biometric-categorisation systems, requires labelling of generative content, and creates an AI Promotion Council. It contains no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Declares AI development of national strategic interest
Sets principles: inclusive growth, human rights, privacy, transparency, robustness, accountability
Bars biometric categorisation inferring sensitive traits and manipulative persuasion systems
Requires labelling/watermarking of realistic generative AI content
Creates a Council for the Promotion and Development of AI under the Cabinet Office, with annual review
